name: Incline Side Plank
steps: Rest one forearm on the bench and stack or stagger your feet on the floor.
Lift your hips until your body forms a straight diagonal line from head to heels, resting your top hand on your hip.
Breathe steadily as you hold your hips in line with your shoulders.
Lower your hips smoothly to finish, then switch sides.
tips: Keep your supporting shoulder packed down and aligned directly over your elbow or wrist.
Prevent your hips from sagging downward or rolling forward toward the floor.
